name: Hitozuma Un'yu Saimin NTR Ben ~Sudou Junko no Yuuwaku~
original_name: 人妻運輸・催眠NTR便 ～須藤順子の誘惑～
source:
He majored in psychology at college. He used the “results” of his research to humiliate those around him. The protagonist, who was expelled from the university and became a criminal, and decided to hide out in the dormitory of a transportation company in a country town.

While he is thinking about quitting his job as a carrier, Junko Sudou joins the company.  She becomes his delivery partner and is kind to Kenichi. Junko is different from the other women he has worked with and they are compatible with each other. 

Kenichi is convinced of this, and he uses the “results” of his hidden research to hypnotize Junko. Thus, Kenichi repeatedly acts with Junko, 

He spends his days in hypnosis and pleasure.  Junko's true nature is gradually revealed, and Kenichi is astonished. And what Kenichi, who loved Junko, saw was something that made him doubt his eyes.

[From [url=http://www.lpv-gamesoft.com/bh/bihf003/index.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
他大学主修心理学，并利用研究“成果”羞辱身边的人。主人公被大学开除后成为罪犯，躲进乡下运输公司的宿舍。

他正考虑辞去搬运工工作时，须藤淳子加入公司。她成为他的送货搭档，对健一很温柔。淳子与他共事过的其他女性不同，两人十分合拍。

健一对此深信不疑，于是利用隐藏研究的“成果”催眠淳子。就这样，健一反复与淳子行动，在催眠与快感中度日。淳子的本性逐渐显露，健一大为震惊。而深爱淳子的健一所看到的真相，让他几乎不敢相信自己的眼睛。
